sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 570)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across urbane society detective mysteries, pivotal wartime presidential radio addresses, Riverdale high school domestic comedies, exotic Far East adventures, and South African radio thrillers, Les Damon and Claudia Morgan in *The Adventures of the Thin Man* (1948, 1950), President Franklin D. Roosevelt's historic Labor Day address from Hyde Park (1941), Burt Boyar in *Archie Andrews* for Swift (1945), *Gentleman Adventurer* (1948), and *The Sounds of Darkness* (1941–1967):
